panels.title: Winner per provider and tier
panels.description: One winner per provider and tier, ordered by the pace of the account window. The capacity and its expiry say whether the winner can be used now.

panels.title: Candidates considered
panels.description: Every candidate that was compared, with the inputs a winner was chosen on: the value, the strength and where it came from, the relative price of the provider's own listing, the benchmark indices, the cost per task, the token prices, the throughput, and whether the model is available. An empty column is an unknown, never a zero.

panels.title: How a winner is calculated
panels.description: The formula, the weights, and the gates of the tiers, as the producer uses them. A suggestion about a weight is a change of this policy and of the producer, and it belongs to the frontier review.

panels.title: Facts and their coverage
panels.description: The durable fact of every model: current, estimated, or pending. An estimate is labelled and bounded, a pending fact waits visibly, and the time of the read says how old the fact is.
